title: Evaluation of automatic bias detection and pre-processing mitigation techniques
summary: A bachelor's thesis codebase evaluating automatic bias detection and pre-processing mitigation techniques for fairness in machine learning, using synthetic data generation to augment and analyze bias in datasets. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE synthesizers alongside sdmetrics quality/fidelity metrics to generate and evaluate synthetic datasets for the bias study.
